zh.summary: 修复旧插件阻塞新内核工作区启动，以及插件依赖重建失败导致整份数据导入撤销的问题。
highlights: 启动前核对已启用社区插件声明的 DSH 兼容范围；不兼容时暂停该插件，保留安装包和配置，让工作区继续打开。
数据导入中若插件依赖无法重建，先回滚失败的插件导入，再导入可用的会话、设置和主凭据；原数据包保留。
Windows 启动超时诊断区分本地服务需要认证与服务不可达，并清除日志中的一次性访问令牌。
knownIssues: 被暂停的旧插件不会自动升级；安装兼容版本后需重新启用。插件导入失败时，原加密数据包中的插件凭据不会导入目标环境。
upgradeNotes: 退出后升级，保留 data 和 workspace。若旧插件被暂停，可在插件页更新并重新启用。

en.summary: Recover workspace startup blocked by an older plugin and preserve usable data when plugin dependency restoration fails during import.
highlights: Check enabled community plugins against their declared DSH peer ranges before startup; pause incompatible bundles while retaining their packages and configuration.
If plugin dependencies cannot be rebuilt during data import, roll back that plugin attempt and import usable sessions, settings and core credentials; retain the original archive.
Distinguish an authenticated local host from an unreachable one in Windows startup diagnostics and redact one-time access tokens.
knownIssues: Paused older plugins are not upgraded automatically; install a compatible version and re-enable them. Plugin credentials in the original encrypted archive are not imported if plugin restoration is deferred.
upgradeNotes: Exit before upgrading and retain data and workspace. Update and re-enable any older plugin paused for incompatibility.
